quotes.author: K Peterson. • Google Reviews
quotes.text: I would highly recommend BluWater. The JetSkis were in excellent condition and came with speakers that were great to listen to while riding. I love that you have the freedom to explore where you want and everything is manageable. Saw a bald eagle, dolphins, and stopped by Cape Romano and Keewaydin Island. Sean and Cam were awesome and gave me a map pointed out all the best spots to check out. When I come back next year, I am definitely going to use them again.

quotes.author: Dedra D. • Google Reviews
quotes.text: Hands down AMAZING! We are a family of 4. We got 2 jet skis. We had Sean as our personal guide for 2 hrs. This was the best 2 ours of our whole trip. Sean explained everything well. He was constantly engaging with us and our kids. We saw dolphins, tons of sting rays, and the abandoned Cape Romano Dome homes. We even stopped at a tucked away beach with the most amazing shells. What a great day.

quotes.author: A. Wrenn. • Google Reviews
quotes.text: Seriously the best place to rent on the island. Best value for your $$$! The jet skis were super nice. Like not the basic cheap rental ones. These were nice ones with bluetooth speakers! We were able to Jason some private beaches we found while riding around unguided. Also saw tons of dolphins! Can’t recommend this place enough. Also do yourself a favor and book at least 3 hours!

quotes.author: C. Cappadona • Google Reviews
quotes.text: We had such a great day with Sean! He took us out on the spot and we were provided with a once in a lifetime private tour. He made everything super easy to follow while taking us through areas we never would have found on our own. He even provided us with a little history lesson! We highly recommend choosing BluWater jet ski rentals and would definitely go out with them again!
